en.s5.p1: Section 4.7 of the Meta Terms for WhatsApp Business Platform bars AI providers when AI is the primary thing being offered, as Meta determines. TechCrunch reported it as a ban on general-purpose chatbots that took effect January 15, 2026 and doesn't affect businesses using AI to serve their own customers. The same terms say a business may still hire an AI provider as its solution provider, as long as WhatsApp data isn't used to train or improve AI models (fine-tuning only for your own exclusive use is allowed).
en.s5.p2: Meta has the final say on its own terms, so I won't call that a guarantee. But an agent that serves your own customers is exactly the use reported as unaffected.

TechCrunch lo reportó como una prohibición de los chatbots de uso general que rige desde el 15 de enero de 2026 y que no afecta a los negocios que usan IA para atender a sus clientes.
